basis: ASSUMED diagnostic screens pre-registered 2026-10-13 before measuring new meshes; these do not certify photographic realism
measurement: Hanging centre: displacement between means of upper and lower quarter vertices divided by their vertical separation, converted to degrees. Fold relief: peak-to-peak x residual after least-squares quadratic fit against y on front-skin vertices in a 20 mm horizontal band halfway down. Hem range: highest minus lowest boundary vertex in the lowest 20 mm. All lengths metres; x along rail, y across depth, z upwards.
